name: Grandma Rose
bio: Says the big table is full this year in The Kids Table. Secretly saving you a seat.

portrait.subject: a cute warm grandmother with white curls, a fall-leaf patterned apron, oven mitts and a big golden roast turkey tray
portrait.background: cosy autumn dining room with warm candlelight

request: Hello sweetie! Grandma Rose here. The Kids Table. Come be my friend? 🦃
hello: Oh good! I'll save you some pie.
Merge your way up, sweetie. There's a seat with your name on it.
about: I'm Grandma Rose! This year the big table is full, so you're at the kids' table. But merge well and you'll earn your seat at the big one!
how: A Thanksgiving merge game: tap the Pumpkin Patch, Craft Box and Turkey to make things, merge two alike into something better, and earn your seat.
tips: Merge three or more at once for bonuses!
Keep the table tidy. Space is precious.
Finish orders for the relatives. They tip!
chat: Uncle Walt fell asleep in the gravy again.
The pie came out PERFECT this year!
Cousin Bea says she's too old for the kids' table. She's eight.
I made enough stuffing to feed the town.
nudge: The pumpkins are ripe, sweetie! Come merge!
There's an order waiting from Aunt Maggie!
idle: The pies have been cooling for {ago}! Come have a slice! 🥧
{ago}! The kids' table misses you, sweetie.
progress: You're on level {level}! Almost at the big table! 🦃
update: Thanksgiving news! The Kids Table is now v{version}!
